_comment: E5 (#1947): write-intent classification for pre-spawn-worktree-guard.mjs. A local (unscoped) name is derived from .claude/agents/*.md — an agent with a `tools:` frontmatter restricted to Read/Grep/Glob (or a description naming it a reviewer/verifier/scanner with no file-mutation role) is read-only; everything else defaults write-intent (fail-closed, see the hook). Kept in parity with .claude/agents/*.md by a carve-out in scripts/check-catalog-agents-parity.mjs (unscoped names only — Claude Code built-ins and `plugin:agent` scoped names are exempt from the local-file check, #2403). Unknown/unlisted type => write-intent by default; write-intent entries below are documented for clarity, not required for correctness.
